description: This file defines the SerialPortTimeoutException class used in the jSSC serial port communication library. It represents exceptions specifically related to timeout events occurring during serial port operations.

classes.name: SerialPortTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating a timeout occurred during a serial port operation. It stores contextual information such as port name, method name, and timeout value.

methods.name: SerialPortTimeoutException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with the port name, method name, and timeout value.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port associated with the timeout exception.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method during which the timeout occurred.

methods.name: getTimeoutValue
methods.description: Returns the timeout value in milliseconds.
